analysis.insight_summary: The user seeks a budget-friendly solution to link [product_name] with a GSM module, avoiding costly proprietary modules. Responses highlight technical limitations: the GSM module must support specific protocols or offer I/O, and the programming port of [product_name] only accepts particular software. The product’s reliance on approved modules makes third-party GSM integration difficult for users looking for cheaper alternatives.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to be compatible with various GSM modules over standard connections like RS232, without needing expensive proprietary hardware.
